'''Gusyin Tatam''' was an [[Aki-Aki]] child that attended the [[Festival of the Ancestors]] in [[35 ABY]].

==Biography==
===Festival of the Ancestors===
[[File:Gusyin_Tatam_Laughing.png|thumb|left|220px|Tatam laughing along with other Aki-Aki children.]]
As a child, Gusyin Tatam attended the [[Festival of the Ancestors]] in the [[Forbidden Valley]] on the Aki-Aki [[homeworld]] [[Pasaana]]<ref name="TROS VD" /> in [[35 ABY]].<ref name="Date">{{FilmDate|IX|Gusyin Tatam's appearance}}</ref> With a mischievous grin,<ref name="TROS VD" /> Tatam sat on a rug under a marquee with a number of other Aki-Aki children to watch a puppet show being performed by an adult Aki-Aki as part of the festival.<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref> The child had brown [[eye]]s and pale skin, and wore [[Color|yellow]] pants and a green [[Clothing|shirt]] with a matching bead necklace.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gusyin Tatam first appeared in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']]<ref name="TROS" /> and was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="TROS VD" /> The character was performed by puppeteer [[Steven Kynman]], who referred to the character using she/her pronouns.<ref name="Puppeteer" />
